title: Privacy Policy
heroSubtitle: Our commitment to protecting and respecting your privacy as part of our business integrity.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.lead: This Privacy Policy explains how PT Lasuarindo Group "Company", "we", or "us" collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit our website at www.lasuarindo.co.id or interact with our services.
introduction.body: As an integrated business & investment company operating in Investment, Property, Technology, Media, F&B, and Lifestyle sectors, we understand the importance of maintaining your trust. This policy applies to all business units and subsidiaries within Lasuarindo Group.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.intro: We may collect and process the following types of information:

usage.title: Information Usage
usage.intro: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:

items.title: Services & Communication
items.desc: Processing inquiries, partnership requests, and providing information about our services across all business sectors.

items.title: Service Improvement
items.desc: Analyzing website usage to improve user experience, content, and platform performance.

items.title: Legal Compliance
items.desc: Complying with legal obligations, regulations, and industry standards applicable in Indonesia, including Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (PDP Law).

items.title: Security
items.desc: Detecting, preventing, and addressing fraudulent activity, misuse, or potential security threats to our services.

protection.title: Data Protection
protection.intro: We are committed to safeguarding your data security by implementing technical and organizational measures in accordance with industry standards.

items.title: SSL/TLS Encryption
items.desc: All data transmission through encrypted protocols.

items.title: Access Control
items.desc: Data access is restricted to authorized personnel only.

items.title: Regular Audits
items.desc: Routine security reviews to maintain data integrity.

sharing.title: Sharing Data with Third Parties
sharing.introSuffix: your personal data to third parties. However, we may share your information under the following limited circumstances:

items.title: Affiliates & Subsidiaries
items.desc: Information may be shared with entities within Lasuarindo Group to support integrated business operations.

items.title: Trusted Service Providers
items.desc: Service partners who assist us in website management, analytics, and communication — all bound by confidentiality agreements.

items.title: Legal Obligations
items.desc: We may disclose data if required by law, legal process, or authorized government requests.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
cookies.intro: Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Below are the types of cookies we use:

callout.text: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

rights.title: User Rights
rights.intro: In accordance with Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (PDP Law), you have the following rights over your personal data:

items.title: Right to Access
items.desc: Request a copy of the personal data we hold.

items.title: Right to Correct
items.desc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.

items.title: Right to Erasure
items.desc: Request deletion of data under certain conditions.

items.title: Right to Restrict
items.desc: Request restriction of your data processing.

items.title: Right to Portability
items.desc: Request your data in a machine-readable format.

items.title: Right to Object
items.desc: Object to data processing for certain purposes.

rights.outroPrefix: To exercise your rights, please contact us via
rights.outroSuffix1: . We will respond to your request within

paragraphs: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Significant changes will be communicated through clear notices on our website.

We recommend that you review this page periodically to stay informed of our latest policies. Continued use of our services after changes are published constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

introLead: PT Lasuarindo Group respects and is strictly committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of your personal data.
